nextStoryContext: post-merge-stalled-marker.ts is I/O-only (POST_MERGE_STALLED_FILENAME, PostMergeStalledMarker { prNumber, issueId, completedSteps, remainingSteps, reason, writtenAt }, read/write/remove, mirrors implement-blocked-marker.ts verbatim: never-throw read with full shape guard, best-effort write, silent-noop remove).
